parent_objective: materialize all 72 M1680 metadata specs into executable P0-compatible env specs without rollout
blocked_by: M1680/M1683 workload metadata is not directly executable

public_gates: M1690 must not run environment rollout
M1690 must materialize 72 executable task specs and 864 workload cells

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns 72 source-budgeted metadata specs into executable P0-compatible task specs before full rollout

stop_condition: stop if any M1680 spec cannot be materialized deterministically
stop if any executable env config violates P0/no-wheel/no-oracle contract
stop if workload cell count is not 864
stop if profile checkpoints/configs are incomplete
fallback_plan: route to materialization repair if source mapping is incomplete
route to workload redesign if M1680 metadata is insufficient
route to full rollout execution design only if materialization passes

allowed_updates: M1690 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up audit or execution-design manifest

any executable env config violates P0/no-wheel/no-oracle contract
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
preflight claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
